title: Test a request in Python
summary: Flask: Test a request in Python. Change the score and compare the test result.
introduction: The test client calls the app without an open port. This example prints the returned JSON score.
learningObjectives: Test a request in Python with Flask
Change the score and compare the test result

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Test a request in Python

blocks.text: The test client executes the view in memory. get_json reads score 8 from its response.
Change the score and compare the test result.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use the test client only for tests; it is not a public server.
